args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

round_money claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN in its docstring and FIN-212 requires
it, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix so half-cents round
to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66), matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP.

This PR changes `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cents round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66), matching the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

- **Diagnosed the failure:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though both its docstring and FIN-212 call for `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail (e.g. `2.665` should round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).
- **Fixed on a new branch:** Created `fin-212-bankers-rounding` and changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **Ran CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed.

The PR is now awaiting alex's review and, per organational policy, code-owner approval before merging into main.
